newsHighlights.title: Diplomats explore Beijing culture, tech in Shijingshan
newsHighlights.summary: Diplomats from several countries toured Beijing's Shijingshan district to experience its cultural heritage and technological innovation.
newsHighlights.translation: 多国驻华外交官走进北京石景山区，亲身感受当地的文化遗产与科技创新。

newsHighlights.title: Cultural exchanges connect Greece and China
newsHighlights.summary: Cultural exchanges between Greece and China are deepening mutual understanding and bringing the two ancient civilizations closer together.
newsHighlights.translation: 中希文化交流不断深化，增进了两国人民的相互理解，让两大古老文明更加亲近。

newsHighlights.title: 'China Haul' goes viral: Empty suitcase in, full load out
newsHighlights.summary: The 'China Haul' trend has gone viral as foreign tourists arrive with empty suitcases and leave with them full of Chinese goods.
newsHighlights.translation: “中国购物”风潮走红网络：外国游客拖着空行李箱来华，满载中国商品而归。

newsHighlights.title: 90 years, mountains behind, stars ahead
newsHighlights.summary: A journey along the Long March route, from the Jinsha River to the Xichang Satellite Launch Center, reveals how much has changed in 90 years.
newsHighlights.translation: 沿着长征路线从金沙江一路走到西昌卫星发射中心，九十年沧桑巨变尽收眼底。

newsHighlights.title: Digital Xiongan: How AI is shaping the smart 'City of the Future'
newsHighlights.summary: AI and digital technologies are shaping Xiongan into a smart 'city of the future' that also attracts curious visitors.
newsHighlights.translation: 人工智能与数字技术正把雄安打造为一座智慧的“未来之城”，也吸引着好奇的游客前来探访。

quote.quote: The world is a book and those who do not travel read only one page.
quote.author: Saint Augustine
quote.translation: 世界是一本书，不旅行的人只读了其中的一页。
quote.explanation: 旅行让人走出熟悉的环境，接触不同的文化与生活方式，从而拓宽视野。正如今日新闻中外交官走进北京街巷、游客满载而归，每一次出行都是在翻阅世界这本大书的新篇章。

vocabulary.definition: 遗产（尤指文化遗产、传统）
vocabulary.example: The diplomats visited Shijingshan to explore both its rich cultural heritage and its modern technology.
vocabulary.translation: 外交官们参观了石景山区，探寻这里丰厚的文化遗产与现代科技。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自新闻《Diplomats explore Beijing culture, tech in Shijingshan》，指石景山区的历史文化遗存。

vocabulary.example: Diplomats from several countries joined the tour of Beijing's Shijingshan district.
vocabulary.translation: 来自多个国家的外交官参加了北京石景山区的参观活动。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出现在标题《Diplomats explore Beijing culture, tech in Shijingshan》中。

vocabulary.example: Cultural exchanges between Greece and China are bringing the two ancient civilizations closer together.
vocabulary.translation: 中希之间的文化交流正让两大古老文明走得更近。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自新闻《Cultural exchanges connect Greece and China》。

vocabulary.definition: （在网络上）迅速传播的，走红的
vocabulary.example: The 'China Haul' trend has gone viral on social media platforms worldwide.
vocabulary.translation: “中国购物”风潮在全球社交媒体上迅速走红。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自新闻标题《'China Haul' goes viral: Empty suitcase in, full load out》。

vocabulary.example: Tourists fill their suitcases with souvenirs and local products before flying home.
vocabulary.translation: 游客们在回国前把行李箱塞满纪念品和当地特产。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联新闻《'China Haul' goes viral》，外国游客来华大量购买纪念品与伴手礼。

vocabulary.example: The diplomats' itinerary included museums, historic sites and tech companies in Shijingshan.
vocabulary.translation: 外交官们的行程包括参观石景山区的博物馆、历史遗迹和科技企业。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联新闻《Diplomats explore Beijing culture, tech in Shijingshan》中的参观行程安排。

vocabulary.example: The Jinsha River crossing is a landmark along the historic Long March route.
vocabulary.translation: 渡过金沙江是长征历史路线上的一个重要节点。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联新闻《90 years, mountains behind, stars ahead》中长征路线上的重要地点。

vocabulary.example: Xiongan is becoming a popular destination for visitors curious about the smart city of the future.
vocabulary.translation: 雄安正成为游客探寻未来智慧城市的热门目的地。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联新闻《Digital Xiongan: How AI is shaping the smart 'City of the Future'》。

vocabulary.example: Foreign shoppers say they are impressed by the quality and craftsmanship of Chinese products.
vocabulary.translation: 外国购物者表示，中国商品的质量与工艺令他们赞叹。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联新闻《'China Haul' goes viral》，外国游客青睐中国制造的工艺与品质。

vocabulary.example: The landscape along the Long March route has changed dramatically over the past 90 years.
vocabulary.translation: 九十年来，长征沿线的风景面貌发生了翻天覆地的变化。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自新闻《90 years, mountains behind, stars ahead》，描写长征沿线山川地貌。

pattern.pattern: be bringing / connecting A and B + 比较级/介词短语（表示“正使A与B更加……”）
pattern.example: Cultural exchanges are bringing the two ancient civilizations closer together.
pattern.translation: 文化交流正让两大古老文明走得更近。
pattern.usage: 该句型用现在进行时表示正在发生的积极趋势，后接“宾语 + 宾补（形容词比较级/介词短语）”。常用于描述文化、旅游、经贸等活动带来的持续性影响。例如：Tourism is connecting small towns with the wider world.

grammar.title: 现在完成时与 go + 形容词（go viral）的搭配
grammar.explanation: 1) 现在完成时（has/have + 过去分词）强调过去发生的动作对现在产生的影响或结果，常与 already、just、yet、recently 等连用。2) 'go + 形容词' 表示状态的转变，如 go viral（走红）、go global（走向世界）、go public（公开）。两者常结合使用，描述某个现象刚刚发生并持续影响当下。
examples: The 'China Haul' trend has gone viral as foreign tourists arrive with empty suitcases.
Citi has received approval to establish a wholly owned securities company in China.

pronunciation.tips: 重音在第一个音节 /ˈher-/，/h/ 要吐气，第二个音节的元音是短元音 /ɪ/，结尾 /ɪtɪdʒ/ 要读得轻快，不要读成 /herɪteidʒ/。注意 -age 在名词中通常读作 /ɪdʒ/，如 village、message。
examples: The city is proud of its cultural heritage.
We should protect our natural heritage for future generations.

reading.title: Traveling China: From Ancient Culture to the 'China Haul'
reading.content:
China is becoming one of the world's most exciting travel destinations. In Beijing's Shijingshan district, diplomats from several countries recently explored museums, historic sites and technology companies, discovering how ancient culture and modern innovation exist side by side. Meanwhile, cultural exchanges between Greece and China are bringing two of the world's oldest civilizations closer together.

Something new is also happening in the shopping world. The 'China Haul' trend has gone viral: foreign tourists arrive with empty suitcases and fly home with them full of local products, from tea and silk to smart gadgets. Many say the quality and craftsmanship of Chinese goods surprise them.

At the same time, journeys along the historic Long March route show visitors a landscape transformed over ninety years. Whether you come for history, technology or shopping, China offers a journey worth taking.
reading.translation:
中国正成为世界上最令人兴奋的旅行目的地之一。在北京石景山区，多国驻华外交官走进博物馆、历史遗迹和科技企业，发现古老文化与现代创新在这里并存。与此同时，中希文化交流正让世界上两个最古老的文明越走越近。

购物领域也出现了新潮流。“中国购物”风潮席卷网络：外国游客拖着空行李箱来华，回国时箱子里装满了茶叶、丝绸、智能小家电等当地特产。许多人说，中国商品的质量和工艺令他们惊喜。

与此同时，沿着长征历史路线旅行的游客，看到的是九十年来沧桑巨变的山河。无论你为历史、科技还是购物而来，中国都值得一游。
reading.sourceNote: 本文基于 2026 年 10 月 24 日 ChinaDaily 与 CGTN 新闻改写，包括《Diplomats explore Beijing culture, tech in Shijingshan》《Cultural exchanges connect Greece and China》《'China Haul' goes viral》《90 years, mountains behind, stars ahead》及《Digital Xiongan》。
